dates.text: octavo idus julii anno a Nativitate Domini millimo quadrimus quadragesimo

data.summary: Felix V appoints Johannes de Cotarello as his mint master (monetarius) and aggregates him to the consortium of other mint masters, requiring him to take an oath before the vice-chamberlain.
